editorial.blurb: This family-owned Mediterranean café in Chicago serves freshly prepared, authentic Middle Eastern dishes in a warm, unpretentious setting that keeps regulars coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit Monday–Thursday 10 AM–8 PM or Friday 10 AM–5 PM for the freshest options; falafel is made to order, so allow a few extra minutes.

topDishes.note: Exceptionally flavorful and made to order
Tender meat, fluffy rice, fresh salad, generous and homemade-tasting
Smooth as silk with a nice sumac accent
